subject: Crescent Med — demo week clash, proposal for recording + live Q&A
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira@crescentmed.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Crescent Med — demo week of Nov 29?

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the runthrough last month. We were planning to host the full clinical ops team the week of Nov 29 for site visits across three of our hospitals — turns out the team will be tied up in back-to-back tours and won't be available for a standard 60–90 minute onsite demo that week.

Would Redwood be able to do one of the following:
- Provide a short recorded walkthrough (15–20 min) of the core flows we care about (privacy controls, inference routing, SDK integration) that our staff can watch asynchronously, plus a 30-minute live Q&A when the team is back (we're thinking Dec 3 afternoon PT) OR
- Move the full live demo to the following week (Dec 6–10) if that's easier for you?

Heads-up: the clinical team will include some staff who need an explicit HIPAA data-handling overview during the Q&A. Also attaching our site-visit itinerary for context.

Thanks — appreciate your flexibility.

Samira
Samira Patel
Director, Clinical Ops
Crescent Medical
(510) 555-0198
Attachment: crescent-itinerary.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@crescentmed.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crescent Med — demo week of Nov 29?

Hi Samira —

Totally understand; site visits can make scheduling tricky. Both options work for us, so we can be flexible. Quick proposal to make it low-effort for your team:

Option A (preferred for speed):
- We’ll record a 15–20 minute walkthrough focused on the flows you called out (privacy controls, routing, SDK integration, and cost/latency profiles).
- Send the recording by Nov 30 so your team can watch before the Q&A.
- Schedule a 30-minute live Q&A on Dec 3 at 10:00 AM PT (we can adjust if that time doesn't work). Karthik (solutions engineer) will cover HIPAA/data handling details; I’ll join for product and use-case discussion. Vivek (your AE) will join for commercial/next steps.

Option B:
- Book a full live walkthrough the week of Dec 6–10. We can split into a 45-minute product demo + 30-minute technical deep-dive to keep it compact.

If you prefer Option A, can you confirm: 1) a headcount for the Q&A, 2) whether Dec 3 10:00 AM PT is acceptable, and 3) any particular HIPAA questions to highlight? I attached a short proposed agenda to this message so folks know what to expect.

Happy to do the full live session if you prefer the extra interaction — let me know.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-agenda.pdf
From: Samira Patel <samira@crescentmed.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@crescentmed.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crescent Med — demo week of Nov 29?

Thanks Rachel — Option A sounds ideal. A few quick answers: 
1) Headcount: expect ~6 people for the live Q&A — mix of clinical ops managers and one IT security lead.
2) Dec 3 at 10:00 AM PT works for the majority; if scheduling conflicts crop up we'll flag them.
3) HIPAA items to highlight: data residency/segregation for patient PHI, audit logging for inference calls, and how Redwood handles tokenization/encryption at rest. If Karthik can carve out 10 minutes for that during the Q&A that would be perfect.

I've looped Rajiv (IT security) onto the thread — he may have a few specific questions to add. Please go ahead with the recording and a calendar hold for Dec 3 (we'll confirm final attendee list by Nov 29).

Samira
